launch_evidence.quote: At the end of May 2021, we launched Qelbree for the treatment of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in pediatric patients 6 to 17 years of age. Net product sales for the second quarter of 2021 were $0.3 million.

search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1356576 (Supernus Pharmaceuticals) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched the exhibits of every 8-K/8-K/A with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2021-07 to 2026-09.

First to third quarters are read from the 'Qelbree' line of the net product sales table in each Form 10-Q (thousands, as the filing states); fourth quarters from the 'Qelbree' line of the Q4 earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, $ millions to one decimal), because the 10-K prints only the full year. Units differ by row and are recorded per row in source_unit.
Prior-year check: the prior-year comparative column of 17 quarterly quotes equals the figure recorded for that earlier quarter from its own filing.
